in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek root 'pauo' (I save), and 'bios' (life), signifying 'savior of life' or 'strong one'

in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin root 'fortis' (strong), and 'bonus' (good), signifying 'strong, good man'
